Items identified in the pre-generation workability review that are polish, not blockers.
Fold these into `Prompt.md` before (or during) code generation when convenient.

## 1. Sound playback must never throw out of the worker

- The Settings sound picker is the system ringtone/notification picker, whose URIs are
  generally readable — but a custom sound URI played from the background `SmsLookupWorker`
  without a persisted grant can throw a `SecurityException`. Worst case today is a crash
  instead of a missing beep.
- Fix (two parts):
  - Add to `Prompt.md` (Opt-Out Detection / Phase 4): sound playback must be wrapped
    defensively — catch any exception, log it, and continue; a failed beep must never fail
    the worker or the reply.
  - Adopt the recommendation from `architectural_analysis.md` §8: when the user selects a
    custom sound URI in Settings, call
    `contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(uri, Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)`
    so the URI stays readable after process death.

## 2. Specify the language-switching mechanism for API 26–32

- Test case #13 requires English/Spanish switching, but `Prompt.md` never names the
  mechanism. On API 33+ the platform handles per-app locales; on API 26–32 it only works
  via AppCompat. A generator might produce something that works only on Android 13+.
- Fix — add to `Prompt.md` (Sound & Language Settings / Phase 7):
  - Use `AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales()` for the language switch.
  - Declare the `androidx.appcompat.app.AppLocalesMetadataHolderService` service with
    `autoStoreLocales` metadata in the manifest so the choice persists on API < 33.
  - `MainActivity` must extend `AppCompatActivity` (not plain `ComponentActivity`) for the
    AppCompat locale APIs to take effect.

## Workflow note (no spec change needed)

- Phase 2 (`RoomDatabaseTest`) and Phase 4 (worker tests via `workmanager-testing`) are
  instrumented tests — phase verification for those two phases needs an emulator or
  connected device, not just the JVM.
